items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 25 at 7:57AM EDT until October 25 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 knots with gusts near 30 knots
and seas 8 to 12 feet through today. Starting tonight, frequent
gusts to Gale force are expected and are forecast to continue
through most of Tuesday. Seas will continue to build and are
expected to peak around 12 to 15 feet on Monday. Gale conditions
should subside to Advisory levels once again by Tuesday night.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach
FL out 20 NM, Coastal waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean
Reef FL out 20 NM, Waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield
Beach FL from 20 to 60 NM and Waters from Deerfield Beach to
Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM excluding the territorial
waters of Bahamas.

* WHEN...Small Craft Advisory, until 8 PM EDT this evening, then a
Gale Warning, from 8 PM this evening to 8 PM EDT Tuesday. A
Small Craft Advisory will then replace the Gale Warning from
midweek onward.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
